stage: P2-RJ Jacobian H1-vs-H4 disambiguation (diagnostic only; evaluator-side; not a method-selection stage)
role: D-dev-select (already exposed; the exact frozen P2-R D1 population; exploratory diagnosis only)

site.state: r = q + u_source at the query predicting token t: the exact DG-02 post-cross-attention / pre-FFN site of the unedited B branch (forced-ZH), teacher-forced on the matched-baseline tokens with the P2-R cached-branch semantics

population.source: results/inference_cf/p2r/population.json d1 (all three strata, all 180 positions, unchanged)

margin.primary: m(r) = logsumexp_{y in Y_ref} z_proc(y) - z_proc(c*)  (processed logits; normalizer-free; equals P2-R margin_ref_vs_competitor at the unedited state)
margin.Y_ref: the frozen P2-R target_ids of the position (reference-consistent first-token set; ZH-correct: the baseline token)
margin.competitor: c* = the first token of the P2-R saved unedited processed top-20 list (rec.none.top_ids) that is not in Y_ref; a fixed token identity per position (EN-confusion: the baseline argmax)
margin.gap: gap = -m(r0) (EN-confusion deficit; > 0 by construction of the stratum except degenerate cases); for EN-correct / ZH-correct m(r0) > 0 is a surplus

secondary_targets.logp_ref: log sum_{y in Y_ref} p_proc(y)  (P2-R L quantity)
secondary_targets.log_PE: log processed mass of the frozen embedded (Latin) token partition
secondary_targets.log_PM: log processed mass of the frozen matrix (Han) token partition

gradient.definition: g = d m / d r at the unedited site state (autograd through the frozen model; a zero-valued probe delta added to u_source at the query, so the forward is value-identical to the unedited step)
gradient.tangent: g_tan = g - rhat <rhat, g>, rhat = r/|r| (NormPreserve edits lie on the |r| sphere to first order)
gradient.use: EVALUATOR-ONLY. The gradient is never applied as a steering direction, never enters a hooked forward with a nonzero edit, and never leaves the diagnostic namespace.

energy.source: the frozen P2-R target realized edit norm (sqrt(1203.3762345332195 / 949)); reused exactly, not tuned

directions.plus_d: d = norm(hE - hB) (core_p1.direction) recomputed at the exact state; must reproduce P2-R cos_d_state
directions.random: the frozen P2-R random vector (inference_cf_p2r.random_direction: seed int(sha256('P2R-random-v1|uid|t')[:16],16), N(0,I_1280), projected orthogonal to r, normalized)
directions.realized_edit: delta_a = apply_steering(r, s_a v_a) - r in the site dtype, with s_a = inference_cf_p2r.solve_scale(r, v_a, e*) (must reproduce the saved P2-R solver s bitwise); geometry only, no model forward with the edit

per_position: A = |g_tan| * e*  (first-order maximum achievable margin change under an e*-size NormPreserve edit)
cos(g_tan, v_a) for v_a in {+d, -d, random} (unit arm directions)
pred_a = <g, delta_a> (first-order predicted margin change of the realized P2-R arm edit)
kappa_a = <g_tan, delta_a> / A  (fraction of the first-order optimum captured by arm a)
same for the secondary targets (logp_ref, log_PE, log_PM): norms, cosines with the arm directions, cos between secondary and primary tangent gradients

bootstrap.aggregation: average positions within dialogue, then across dialogues

analysis.simultaneous: Bonferroni over the decision family: each two-sided at alpha = 0.05/2 (percentiles 0.0125, 0.9875)
analysis.Q50: dialogue-weighted fraction of valid EN-confusion positions with rho >= 0.5
analysis.K_plus: dialogue-weighted mean of kappa_plus over valid EN-confusion positions

diagnosis.P2_RJ_SITE_OR_SENSITIVITY_ISSUE: valid and WEAK and (PARTIAL or ALIGNED)
diagnosis.P2_RJ_STILL_AMBIGUOUS: otherwise (including any validity failure, UNRESOLVED leverage, SUBSTANTIAL with PARTIAL/ALIGNED)

validity.V1_provenance: manifest, config, population, source hashes and Git commit verify
validity.V2_completeness: every utterance row ok; all 180 positions present
validity.V3_state_identity: per position: recomputed baseline processed argmax == baseline_token == P2-R none.argmax; |logp_ref - P2-R none.logp_ref| <= 1e-3; |m(r0) - P2-R margin| <= 1e-3; |r| == P2-R pre_norm (rel 1e-6); |cos_d_state - P2-R| <= 1e-6; recomputed c* equals the frozen c*; recomputed solver s equals the saved P2-R s for all three arms (rel 1e-9); grad-step logits bitwise equal to the no-grad step logits. Mismatching positions are excluded and counted; more than 9 of 180 mismatches (5%) = run invalid (implementation defect)
validity.V6_fd_sign: first-order sanity: pooled Pearson r between pred_a and the observed P2-R arm change of m (fixed competitor, from the saved arm top-20) over all valid (position, arm) pairs, dialogue bootstrap (10000, seed 240924, pointwise 95%): lower bound > 0
validity.V7_precision: fp32 recomputation (same bf16 weights cast to fp32, same prefixes): median over valid positions of cos(g_tan_bf16, g_tan_fp32) >= 0.9, AND the fp32 diagnosis label (same rules, analytic float64 chord edits of length e*) equals the bf16 label

analysis.fd_descriptive: slope (through origin) and Pearson r of observed vs predicted, per arm and per stratum, for m and for logp_ref

precision.gradient_dtype: probe delta float32 -> cast to site dtype; gradient read in float32; all geometry in CPU float64
